concerns.text: No task validates the data‑model contracts (e.g., `dataset.schema.yaml`, `evaluation_result.schema.yaml`, `feature_set.schema.yaml`). The plan’s contracts are a required artifact, yet there is no checklist item that runs schema validation or records compliance, leaving FR‑030 (Constitution) uncovered.

The specification and constitution require reproducibility (random‑seed pinning) and data‑hygiene (checksums of raw/processed files). No task explicitly pins seeds in the scripts or records file checksums, so FR‑030 clauses I and III are not covered by any task.
